name: Zion Clark
headline: Athlete born without legs: wrestler, pro MMA fighter, three-time Guinness World Records holder and subject of the Emmy-winning Netflix film ZION.
formats: Keynotes for companies, sales teams, schools and athletes; brand partnerships and appearances

summary: Zion Clark was born without legs due to caudal regression syndrome and grew up in Ohio's foster care system before being adopted. He went winless for years on the wrestling mat, then finished his senior season at Massillon Washington High School 33–15, one match from the state championships. Since then he has set three Guinness World Records, won his professional MMA debut and starred in ZION, the Sundance-selected Netflix documentary that won two Sports Emmys. On stage he teaches his No Excuses, Be Greater Than mindset to companies, students, athletes and nonprofit leaders.

talks: No Excuses: the mindset that took him from winless seasons to a 33–15 senior year, Guinness World Records and pro MMA. Keynote.
Be Greater Than: practical steps and a toolbox for achieving what looks impossible, for teams facing change and pressure. Keynote for companies and sales teams.
Work with What You Got: from foster care to the national stage, on resilience, identity and making the most of what you have. Keynote or school assembly.
